documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Meeting Of Board Of Grameva Limited (Formerly Known As Bangalore Fort Farms Limited) ('Company') Held On Friday, July 10, 2026. Regulation 30 Read With Schedule III Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.
Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 ('Listing Regulations')
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Grameva Limited reported significant financial growth for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, with revenue from operations increasing to Rs. 8,268.09 Lakhs and profit after tax rising to Rs. 301.73 Lakhs. During the year, the company changed its name from Bangalore Fort Farms Limited to Grameva Limited and expanded into the beverage solutions segment with the coffee brand "Brew Factor". The management also initiated new business verticals including layer farming, feed mill operations, piggery, and the trading of fish to diversify operations.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the agriculture and allied sectors continue to be a critical pillar of India's economy.
demand_outlook.quote: The agriculture and allied sectors continue to be a critical pillar of India's economy, employing nearly 43% of the workforce and contributing around 18% to the national GDP.

demand_outlook.claim: India's agro-processing industry is gaining strategic significance due to increasing global demand for sustainable and traceable food supply chains.
demand_outlook.quote: With increasing global demand for sustainable and traceable food supply chains, India’s agro-processing industry is gaining strategic significance.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that demand for Jute Goods remained robust in domestic markets, contributing to stable operations and sustained business growth.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand for Jute Goods remained robust in domestic markets, contributing to stable operations and sustained business growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved several strategic initiatives to scale warehousing operations and explore adjacent opportunities.
capex_expansion.quote: The Board has approved several strategic initiatives to scale our warehousing operations further and explore adjacent opportunities, including food processing and agri-infrastructure development.

margins_costs.claim: The company experienced pressures on profitability from increased raw material costs, higher finance costs, and slowdown in market demand.
margins_costs.quote: The Company has reported inadequate profits during the year primarily on account of increased cost of raw materials, higher finance costs and overall slowdown in market demand, which adversely impacted margins.

capital_allocation.claim: The company chose to retain the entire earnings to strengthen the balance sheet and fund future expansion initiatives, resulting in no dividend being declared.
capital_allocation.quote: In line with its long-term strategy, the Company has chosen to retain the entire earnings to further strengthen the balance sheet and fund future expansion initiatives. Consequently, no dividend has been declared for the year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of Rs. 0.20 per equity share for the financial year ended March 31, 2024.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors recommend a dividend of Rs. 0.20/- per equity shares of the company for the year under review to the shareholders whose name appears on the register of members as on the record date.

capital_allocation.claim: The company transferred a profit of Rs. 34,46,941 to Surplus Account during the year.
capital_allocation.quote: The company transferred profit of Rs. 34,46,941/- to Surplus A/c during the year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that fluctuations in commodity prices, supply chain challenges, and changing market dynamics continued to influence the overall business environment.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, fluctuations in commodity prices, supply chain challenges, and changing market dynamics continued to influence the overall business environment.

risks_headwinds.claim: Profitability was adversely impacted by increased cost of raw materials, higher finance costs, and overall slowdown in market demand.
risks_headwinds.quote: The Company has reported inadequate profits during the year primarily on account of increased cost of raw materials, higher finance costs and overall slowdown in market demand, which adversely impacted margins.

management_commitments.claim: The company anticipates that productivity will increase by around 10-15% supported by capacity utilization and process improvements.
management_commitments.quote: It is anticipated that productivity will increase by around 10–15% over the next 2–3 years, supported by better capacity utilization and process improvements.

management_commitments.claim: The company projects an improvement in profitability margins by 8-12% in the medium term.
management_commitments.quote: Consequently, the Company projects an improvement in profitability margins by 8–12% in the medium term, subject to normal market conditions.

management_commitments.claim: The company scheduled its 57th Annual General Meeting for Monday, September 30, 2024.
management_commitments.quote: The 57th Annual General Meeting (AGM) of the Company is scheduled to be held at 16A, Brabourne Road, 6th Floor, Kolkata- 700001 and through Video Conferencing (VC) and Other Audio Visual Means (OAVM) on Monday, 30th September 2024 at 02.30 p.m.

management_commitments.claim: The Register of Members and Share Transfer books were set to remain closed from Monday, September 23, 2024, to Monday, September 30, 2024.
management_commitments.quote: The Register of Members and the Share Transfer books would remain closed from Monday, 23rd September 2024 to Monday, 30th September 2024 (both days inclusive) for the purpose of Annual General Meeting.

management_commitments.claim: Remote e-voting was scheduled to begin on September 27, 2024, at 09:00 A.M. and end on September 29, 2024, at 05:00 P.M.
management_commitments.quote: The remote e-voting period begins on 27-09-2024 at 09:00 A.M. and ends on 29-09-2024 at 05:00 P.M.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
